# Demographics

This folder contains demographic variables tracked in healthcare metrics, specifically focusing on patient age (alder) across different regions. The pages here detail how demographic factors are analyzed in clinical databases, including supplementary boxplot analyses that reveal whether patient demographics vary significantly between regional health authorities.

## Pages

- [[alder]] — Analyzes the "alder" (age) demographic variable for operated patients, including a regional boxplot comparison that finds no significant age differences across Denmark's five regions.
